تنتابون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَابُونَ (tantābūna) /tan.taː.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَابَ (intāba)
# تُنْتَابُونَ (tuntābūna) /tun.taː.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَابَ (intāba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
